articles.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
articles.snippet: The majority leader opened the multi-stage process the Senate follows when trying to get a bill over its 60-vote hurdle, so it's still got a shot in September.

articles.title: New XRP Ledger amendments target $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets
articles.snippet: A new XRPL amendment proposal would let institutions encrypt token balances and transfer amounts while still giving issuers, auditors and regulators selective access.

articles.title: Bitcoin holders risk losing real BTC if they sell coins from BIP-110 fork, says developer
articles.snippet: If a minority chain appears this weekend, buyers could replay signed fork-coin sales on bitcoin itself, making doing nothing the safest move until the chains can be separated.

articles.title: OKX's Rafique doubts Clarity Act will pass, warns optimism is already priced into bitcoin
articles.snippet: The OKX executive says Democrats have little incentive to hand Republicans a crypto victory before the midterms.

articles.title: Why Bitcoin's BIP-110 refuses to die despite near-zero miner support
articles.snippet: BIP-110 has attracted only a sliver of miner support, yet its user-activated design means the proposal continues toward its activation date and (most likely) beyond.
